# Silk Route

> Silk Route is a private luxury chauffeur service in Cape Town, South Africa, offering pre-booked travel in a Mercedes-Benz V300d Exclusive AMG Line.

## Core facts

- Service area: Cape Town; wider Western Cape itinerary requirements are confirmed per enquiry.
- Featured vehicle: Mercedes-Benz V300d Exclusive AMG Line with a black leather cabin.
- Passenger capacity: up to 6 passengers.
- Telephone and WhatsApp: +27 74 537 7310.
- Canonical website: https://silkroute.vip/

## Chauffeur services and published prices

- Daily Chauffeur Service: R7,500 for 12 hours, extendable.
- Multi-day Chauffeur Service: R7,150 for 12 hours, extendable.
- Dinner Service: R3,950 for 4.5 hours, extendable.
- Point-to-Point and Event Transfers: R1,950 for up to 2 hours, extendable.
- Optional extras: Wi-Fi, baby car seat, and an Executive Package with a printer, scanner, copier, shredder and onboard UPS.

Extensions, itinerary changes and optional extras are quoted for the specific journey.

## Booking

Use the Book Your Journey form to prepare a WhatsApp enquiry with the service, date, time, collection point, destination, passenger count, luggage and special requirements. The website does not store the form submission.

The linked website pages are the authoritative source if details change.
